title: Library classification
bodyMd: A librarian finds that books on migration are scattered among economics, history, and literature. Rather than move every book into one new section, she adds a cross-search tag. Researchers can then discover related books while the original subject arrangements remain. She warns that the tag is an aid to discovery, not a claim that all tagged books use the same methods or reach the same conclusions.
